verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents several built-in AI features that draw insights from customer data. Offer Forecast uses machine learning to flag whether roles are on track. Talent Matching analyzes applications and sorts them into tiers by relevance and risk. The Notetaker maps AI-generated interview summaries to scorecard questions, and pricing lists AI-powered report filters. missing for 10: a general-purpose AI insights or assistant layer for ad-hoc questions across reporting data, in-depth documentation of how suggestions are generated and surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing).
